friendly_name: Portable shell config across both machines
purpose_context: The account router that decides whether a session runs as kent@spec-kitty.ai or kent@intentional.biz currently exists in exactly two untracked files. Four defects surfaced during the office4 migration, all found by testing rather than reading: a work repo silently routed to the personal account; brew captured python3 at 3.14 via a transitive node dependency; direnv was hooked into bash on a machine whose login shell is zsh; and PATH set in .zprofile was invisible to the SSH invocations that drive office4. Each was 'it works in the shell I happened to test'. The durable fix is one versioned source plus a verification helper, not tidier files.
purpose_tldr: Extract shell configuration into the private kentonium3/dotfiles repo so the Mac and office4 read one versioned source, and add a helper that asserts the whole shell environment rather than trusting it.
